purpose: Independently authored adversarial evidence-selection cases. Expected support follows the explicit text, not model agreement or model-generated labels. This diagnostic corpus does not estimate live-site accuracy.

cases.claim: Vous pouvez demander l'effacement de vos données personnelles.
cases.support: Sur simple demande, nous supprimons les informations personnelles vous concernant.
cases.contradiction: Vous ne pouvez pas demander l'effacement de vos données personnelles.
cases.judge_reason: The second text expressly denies the requested possibility; shared erasure vocabulary does not make it support.

cases.claim: Le compte coûte 15 euros par mois.
cases.support: Les frais mensuels de tenue de ce compte s'élèvent à quinze euros.
cases.contradiction: Le compte coûte 25 euros par mois.
cases.judge_reason: The stated amount must equal 15, not 25.

cases.claim: Vos données sont conservées pendant 30 jours.
cases.support: Les informations personnelles sont supprimées après un mois de trente jours.
cases.contradiction: Vos données sont conservées pendant 300 jours.
cases.judge_reason: 300 days contradicts 30 days; topical retention similarity cannot prove the duration.

cases.claim: Vous pouvez annuler votre abonnement sans frais.
cases.support: La résiliation de l'abonnement est gratuite.
cases.contradiction: Vous pouvez annuler votre abonnement avec des frais de résiliation.
cases.judge_reason: Cancellation availability and free cancellation are different claims.

cases.claim: Vous pouvez consulter vos données personnelles.
cases.support: Une copie des informations vous concernant peut vous être communiquée sur demande.
cases.contradiction: Vous ne pouvez pas consulter vos données personnelles.
cases.judge_reason: An explicit denial cannot serve as evidence that access is available.

cases.claim: You can request deletion of your personal data.
cases.support: Ask us to remove the personal information we hold about you.
cases.contradiction: You cannot request deletion of your personal data.
cases.judge_reason: Cannot reverses the proposition despite nearly identical terms.

cases.claim: The account costs 15 euros per month.
cases.support: The monthly charge for this account is fifteen euros.
cases.contradiction: The account costs 25 euros per month.
cases.judge_reason: A price of 25 is not evidence for the stated price of 15.

cases.claim: Your data is retained for 30 days.
cases.support: We delete your personal information after a thirty-day period.
cases.contradiction: Your data is retained for 300 days.
cases.judge_reason: The duration is ten times the claim.

cases.claim: You can cancel your subscription without a fee.
cases.support: Subscription cancellation is free of charge.
cases.contradiction: You can cancel your subscription with a cancellation fee.
cases.judge_reason: Both texts concern cancellation, but only the free option supports this claim.

cases.claim: You can access your personal data.
cases.support: A copy of the information we hold about you is available on request.
cases.contradiction: You cannot access your personal data.
cases.judge_reason: The contradiction denies access; shared topic is not supporting evidence.

cases.support: نزيل المعلومات الشخصية المتعلقة بك عند تقديم طلب بذلك.
cases.contradiction: لا يمكنك طلب حذف بياناتك الشخصية.
cases.judge_reason: لا يمكنك denies the possibility that the claim grants.

cases.support: التكلفة الشهرية لهذا الحساب هي خمسة عشر يورو.
cases.judge_reason: 25 differs from the expressly claimed monthly amount of 15.

cases.support: نحذف معلوماتك الشخصية بعد مرور ثلاثين يوماً.
cases.judge_reason: The contradiction states a different retention duration.

cases.support: إنهاء الاشتراك مجاني ولا يتطلب دفع أي مبلغ.
cases.judge_reason: دون رسوم and مقابل رسوم disagree on whether payment is required.

cases.support: تستطيع الحصول على نسخة من المعلومات المتعلقة بك عند طلبها.
cases.contradiction: لا يمكنك الاطلاع على بياناتك الشخصية.
cases.judge_reason: An explicit negation cannot substantiate the access claim.
